admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent; unified admission via Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
admission_requirements.exam_details: No entrance exam required; admission based on Tawjihi scores and unified admission criteria

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: 600-1500 JOD per year (estimated based on per-credit-hour fees)
tuition_fees.notes: Fees are per credit hour; Jordanian morning students pay 20-50 JOD/credit hour depending on program. No medical programs offered.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan, Association of Arab Universities (AAU), International Association of Universities (IAU), Federation of the Universities of the Islamic World (FUIW)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: Times Higher Education Impact Rankings 2025 (801-1000th); QS Arab Region Rankings (151-160); Webometrics World Rank 4790 (2026)

campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Financial aid and scholarship programs available for local and international students

contact_info.address: P.O. Box 179, University Street, Tafila, 66110, Jordan
